scope:
138 documented Greenhouse Harvest operations, re-derived 2026-08-07 from developers.greenhouse.io/harvest.html (HTTP 200, 1,636,662 bytes). Greenhouse publishes no OpenAPI/Swagger for Harvest, so each operation is taken from the canonical '

HTTP Request

METHOD https://harvest.greenhouse.io/vN/path

' declaration that follows every endpoint section - 138 declarations, zero duplicates, reconciling exactly with the provider-artifact ledger. Method split GET 69 / POST 28 / PUT 8 / PATCH 19 / DELETE 14. Every row carries exactly one disposition: covered_by, or a blocked operation naming what it waits on. Harvest v1 paths are base-relative; the eight Harvest v2 operations are recorded at their documented host-root path (/v2/...) because they lie outside this bundle's single /v1 base. Webhook events are excluded by the counting policy and Greenhouse documents them on a separate page (developers.greenhouse.io/webhooks.html); Harvest exposes no webhook management endpoints, so this surface carries zero webhook rows of either kind.

operation.reason: Greenhouse marks this Harvest v1 mutation (DELETE: Destroy Openings) DEPRECATED in its own reference - the declaration is wrapped in DEPRECATED... markup - and directs callers to DELETE /v2/jobs/{job_id}/openings. Deprecated operations still count toward the documented surface, so this is dispositioned rather than dropped, but it is not implemented: shipping a mutation the provider has retired would be a liability, and its replacement is itself out of base.
operation.notes: Named dependency: DELETE /v2/jobs/{job_id}/openings, which is blocked on the same per-operation base URL override every Harvest v2 row waits on. When that lands, implement the v2 replacement; this v1 row stays deprecated.

operation.reason: Harvest v2 operation. This bundle binds exactly one HTTPBase, https://harvest.greenhouse.io/v1 (spec.json base_url), and every stream and write path is resolved relative to it, so a /v2 path cannot be addressed: a base-relative form builds .../v1/v2/..., and an absolute form is rejected because engine.deriveOperationDirectReadEndpointLedger only emits a runtime endpoint-ledger entry when operation.rest.path equals an api_surface row verbatim. Correct URL construction and ledger membership cannot both hold for an out-of-base path.
operation.notes: Named dependency: per-operation base URL override in internal/connectors/engine, so a single bundle can address more than one API version prefix without restructuring every existing stream and write path in lockstep. Recorded at its documented host-root path (/v2/...) so it cannot collide with a base-relative v1 row.
